changes: A sword, in the creative inventory's new Weapons group: swing it level or overhead, as the axe.
Deer and wolves can be hurt and killed with it: each hit lands as the blade reaches them, knocks them back, and wears the sword.
Hurt deer run off; hurt wolves turn on you, and flee when badly wounded. A killed animal leaves raw meat.
Villagers can be struck too, and turn to face whoever hit them. A sword never hurts another player.
